title: [Riso] Lesson Creation Form – Course Field – Teaching Method Individual selected – Course field shown and optional
description: AC 03.1 + AC 03.2 — Component — When Teaching Method = Individual is selected in the Riso lesson creation form, the Course field appears and is not marked as required.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nOn the New Lesson creation form
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson
2. Select Teaching Method = Individual
3. Observe the Course field on the form
4. Observe whether the Course field is marked as required
5. Leave Course blank, fill other required fields, and click Save
steps_result:
1. Lesson creation form opens
2. Teaching Method shows Individual
3. Course field is visible on the form
4. Course field is not marked as required (no asterisk or required indicator)
5. Lesson saved without a validation error for Course

title: [Riso] Lesson Creation Form – Course Field – Teaching Method Group selected – Course field not shown
description: AC 03.1 — Conditional logic (Negative) — When Teaching Method = Group, the Course field is not shown in the Riso lesson creation form.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nOn the New Lesson creation form
steps_actions: 1. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson\n2. Select Teaching Method = Group\n3. Observe the form for the Course field
steps_result: 1. Lesson creation form opens\n2. Teaching Method shows Group\n3. Course field is not visible (hidden for Group teaching method)

title: [Riso] Lesson – Create Lesson – Individual TM, Course blank – Lesson saved and Name generated from Subject alone
description: AC 03.2 — Equivalence Partitioning — Course is optional for Individual TM; lesson saves with Course blank, and Lesson Name is generated from Subject only.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nSubject Master contains Physics\nNew lesson not yet saved
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson
2. Set Teaching Method = Individual
3. Select Subject = Physics
4. Leave Course blank
5. Fill required fields and click Save
6. Open the lesson detail and observe Lesson Name
steps_result:
1. Lesson creation form opens
2. Course field appears
3. Subject shows Physics
4. Course field remains empty
5. Lesson saved without error (no Course required)
6. Lesson Name = Physics

title: [Riso] Lesson – Create Lesson – Individual TM, Subject and Course provided – Course contributes to auto-generated name
description: AC 03.3 — Decision Table — When Teaching Method = Individual and both Subject = Chemistry and Course = Course C are provided, Lesson Name = Chemistry - Course C.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org\nSubject Chemistry and Course Course C exist in master data\nNew lesson not yet saved
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson
2. Set Teaching Method = Individual
3. Select Subject = Chemistry
4. Select Course = Course C
5. Fill required fields and click Save
6. Open the lesson detail and observe Lesson Name
steps_result:
1. Lesson creation form opens
2. Course field appears
3. Subject shows Chemistry
4. Course shows Course C
5. Lesson saved
6. Lesson Name = Chemistry - Course C (Course contributed to name generation)
